bank_accounts_manual_anchor.name: bank_accounts_manual_anchor
bank_accounts_manual_anchor.value: ("bank_accounts"."connection_id" IS NULL) = ("bank_accounts"."declared_on" IS NOT NULL AND "bank_accounts"."declared_balance_minor" IS NOT NULL)

bank_accounts_synced_refs.name: bank_accounts_synced_refs
bank_accounts_synced_refs.value: "bank_accounts"."connection_id" IS NULL OR ("bank_accounts"."stable_ref" IS NOT NULL AND "bank_accounts"."provider_account_ref" IS NOT NULL)

account_balances_scope.name: account_balances_scope
account_balances_scope.using: "account_balances"."household_id" = keel_current_household() AND ("account_balances"."private_to" IS NULL OR "account_balances"."private_to" = keel_current_member())
account_balances_scope.withCheck: "account_balances"."household_id" = keel_current_household() AND ("account_balances"."private_to" IS NULL OR "account_balances"."private_to" = keel_current_member())

transactions_scope.name: transactions_scope
transactions_scope.using: "transactions"."household_id" = keel_current_household() AND ("transactions"."private_to" IS NULL OR "transactions"."private_to" = keel_current_member())
transactions_scope.withCheck: "transactions"."household_id" = keel_current_household() AND ("transactions"."private_to" IS NULL OR "transactions"."private_to" = keel_current_member())

transactions_identity.name: transactions_identity
transactions_identity.value: ("transactions"."fingerprint" IS NULL) = ("transactions"."occurrence" IS NULL) AND ("transactions"."origin" = 'manual' OR "transactions"."fingerprint" IS NOT NULL)
